stage: 小学四五年级 · 每日 2 词

base.example: I hope you feel better soon.

root.logic: hope 是树干，意思是“希望”。挂 -ful 是“有希望的”，挂 -less 是“绝望的”，再加 -ly 就是“但愿、有希望地”。尾巴可以一层一层叠。

family.example: We are hopeful about the match.
family.exampleZh: 我们对这场比赛抱有希望。

family.example: Don't feel hopeless after one bad test.
Hopefully, it will be sunny tomorrow.
He looked hopelessly at the broken bike.
family.exampleZh: 他绝望地看着坏掉的自行车。

rule.tip: hopeful → hopefully 是两层尾巴。同样的路子还有 careful → carefully、successful → successfully。拆开看，长词就不可怕。
